description: This is a test class for the TimesheetDao component in the OrangeHRM system, containing unit tests for CRUD operations, retrieval functions, and validation logic related to timesheets and associated entities.

classes.name: TimesheetDaoTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the TimesheetDao functionalities, including creation, retrieval, duplication checks, and report generation related to timesheets.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating TimesheetDao and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testAddTimesheet
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new Timesheet entity.

methods.name: testDuplicateTimesheet
methods.description: Checks whether duplicate timesheets for given dates and employee IDs exist.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetActionLogs
methods.description: Validates retrieval of timesheet action logs for a specific timesheet.

methods.name: testAddTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Tests saving a new timesheet action log entry.

methods.name: testGetMyTimesheets
methods.description: Tests fetching timesheets filtered by employee number and date range.

methods.name: testIsDuplicateTimesheetItem
methods.description: Checks whether a timesheet item is a duplicate based on project, activity, and timesheet IDs.

methods.name: testAddTimesheetItem
methods.description: Tests the creation and saving of a timesheet item.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemById
methods.description: Fetches a specific timesheet item by Timesheet ID and Timesheet Item ID.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetById
methods.description: Retrieves a Timesheet by its ID.

methods.name: testSaveAndUpdateTimesheetItemsExceptionCase
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when saving invalid timesheet items with mismatched project and activity associations.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTimesheetList
methods.description: Verifies fetching a list of timesheets based on employee and status filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTimesheetListCount
methods.description: Validates the count of timesheets retrieved with filters.

methods.name: testGetLatestTimesheet
methods.description: Tests fetching the most recent timesheet based on date filters.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemsForEmployeeReportAndTotalHours
methods.description: Checks retrieval of timesheet items and total hours for employee reports with various filters.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemsCountForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Validates count of report entries matching filter criteria.

methods.name: testTimesheetAvailability
methods.description: Checks the presence or absence of timesheet items for specific project, timesheet, activity, and date combination.
